svg.title: HERD experiment data context with FTS at IHEP
svg.desc: CERN in Europe sends Beam Test Data to IHEP in Beijing. A dashed planned logical Raw data path is shown from the Chinese Space Station to IHEP for the planned HERD deployment in 2029. The station is a schematic and is not presented as an operational satellite; the space-to-ground path is not claimed to use FTS.
